interpretation.positions: BGT paal plus_type=lichtmast 2D coordinates, existing status, exact municipality clip
interpretation.coverage: Exclude only surveyed plan points within 0.1m of a native prepared pole base. This bound exceeds <=2cm/axis native-output quantization error; the observed nearest-neighbour distribution is retained below. Distinct nearby points are preserved beyond this match bound.
interpretation.height: Ground is sampled from retained AHN6 0.5m DTM, nearest-cell height or median valid cell within 2m for no-data. No valid ground means omission. Same NAP numeric/Earth-curvature convention as other model layers. Head height is illustrative 10m above measured ground; BGT does not survey mast heights.
interpretation.light: Warm head glow and 9m light pools use existing lamp materials; pools only if full footprint lies inside municipality and outside unsimplified BRT water polygons. Pole heads/pools are illustration, not live operational status.
